correctness.rationale: Root-link simplex-and-cones deformation contraction is valid since every complementary leaf set is nonempty for a>=2. Deletion joins star factors; each has free reduced H_1 equal to leaf augmentation kernel A_b. Integral join Kunneth gives only degree 2a-1 and tensor module; degree-one join twists have sign (-1)^4=+1 under arm permutation. Cyclic factor traces are fix(leaf return permutation)-1. b=1 factors vanish, consistent with contractibility. This is an all-parameter proof rather than an inference from finite tests.
